verses.text: and he said: “I called out from the distress of mine to YHWH, and He answered me; from the belly of Sheol I cried out—You heard my voice.

verses.text: And You cast me [into] the deep, into the heart of the seas, and the current surrounded me; all Your billows and Your waves passed over me.

verses.text: And I said, ‘I have been driven out from before Your eyes; yet I will add to look toward the temple of Your holiness.’

verses.text: The waters surrounded me up to the soul, the deep closed around me, the seaweed wrapped around my head.

verses.text: To the bases of the mountains I went down; the earth with her bars [was] behind me forever. And You brought up my life from the pit, O YHWH my God.

verses.text: At the fainting within me of my soul, I remembered YHWH; my prayer came in to You, to the temple of Your holiness.
